findings.evidenceJa: 昏い感情が染み付いたそこ
findings.governingReading: the place, steeped in dark emotions
findings.explanation: The moral and atmospheric darkness of Shinji’s frustration, obsession, envy, and jealousy is omitted.

findings.evidenceJa: 舌打ちは、それこそ彼の妄想である
findings.governingReading: That tongue-click is itself born of his delusion
findings.explanation: A local narrative qualification of Shinji’s reaction is broadened into a declaration that everything just described is delusion.

findings.highlight: told him a bit of what happened here
findings.evidenceJa: 一部始終教えてくれた
findings.governingReading: told him everything that happened here, from beginning to end
findings.explanation: Zouken’s claimed disclosure of the entire history becomes only partial information, changing the stated bounds of Shinji’s knowledge.

findings.evidenceJa: 保菌者だった
findings.governingReading: a carrier—a bearer of the bloodline trait
findings.explanation: The English preserves only the ruby reading “Carrier” and drops the written image of someone carrying a pathogen or taint.

findings.highlight: that which gave birth to his unskillful body
findings.evidenceJa: 劣った自分を生んだ胎盤
findings.governingReading: the placenta that gave birth to his inferior self
findings.explanation: Shinji’s misogynistic reduction of his mother to a placenta and his judgment of himself as inferior become an abstract agent and merely an “unskillful body.”

findings.evidenceJa: 蟲どもが地面を覆っている
findings.governingReading: the worms cover the ground
findings.explanation: A spatially overwhelming carpet of worms becomes incidental wriggling, an action not stated here.

findings.evidenceJa: ヌメヌメと光る黒い粘虫
findings.governingReading: black slugs or sticky worms gleaming with slime
findings.explanation: The wall shadows’ wet shine, black color, and sluglike texture collapse into generic bugs.

findings.evidenceJa: 赤い瞳が無造作に向けられる
findings.governingReading: The red eyes turn toward him with careless indifference
findings.explanation: The direction and Gilgamesh’s dismissively casual manner disappear.

findings.evidenceJa: 使い魔にすぎない
findings.governingReading: nothing more than a familiar—what Shinji calls a Servant
findings.explanation: The written term “familiar,” crucial to Shinji’s belittling conception of the relationship, disappears behind the ruby “Servant.”

findings.highlight: he’s good at determining who’s strong
findings.evidenceJa: 人を見る目だけはある
findings.governingReading: at least he has an eye for people
findings.explanation: Shinji’s broad, self-serving claim that Kotomine can judge people becomes a specific ability to measure strength.

findings.evidenceJa: 愉快げな忍び笑い
findings.governingReading: an amused, suppressed chuckle
findings.explanation: A furtive snicker that characterizes Shinji’s smugness becomes open laughter.

findings.highlight: Go ahead and kill all you want
findings.evidenceJa: てっとり早く殺しまくってさ
findings.governingReading: quickly go on a killing spree
findings.explanation: Shinji’s expedient command to kill indiscriminately becomes permission for Archer to satisfy a presumed desire to kill.

findings.highlight: Archer watches as if something unpleasant has touched him
findings.evidenceJa: その手を、何か不快なものに触れた、という眼でアーチャーは観察する
findings.governingReading: Archer examines that hand with the look one gives something unpleasant that has touched him
findings.explanation: The object of Gilgamesh’s disgust—the hand on his shoulder—disappears, making the English sound as though an unspecified thing touched Archer.

findings.evidenceJa: セイバーを屈従させ
findings.governingReading: forcing Saber into submission
findings.explanation: One conditional English variant converts Shinji’s fantasy of subjugating Saber into explicit rape, a materially stronger event not stated by the Japanese wording.

findings.highlight: I shall take part in that joy
findings.evidenceJa: オマエの遊びにも付き合おう
findings.governingReading: I shall indulge your little game as well
findings.explanation: Gilgamesh’s contemptuous framing of Shinji’s revenge as his “play” becomes shared joy and sounds more approving.

findings.highlight: existed since the last Holy Grail War
findings.evidenceJa: 前回の聖杯戦争から留まり続けている
findings.governingReading: has remained in this world continuously since the previous Holy Grail War
findings.explanation: Gilgamesh’s anomalous continued presence after the prior war becomes mere existence since that date.

findings.highlight: I cannot stand giving it to the meaningless extras
findings.evidenceJa: 余分なモノに与える意義などない
findings.governingReading: there is no value in granting anything to what is superfluous
findings.explanation: A cold value judgment becomes personal irritation, introduces an unclear pronoun “it,” and weakens “superfluous” into “meaningless extras.”

findings.evidenceJa: 十人の奴隷
findings.governingReading: ten slaves
findings.explanation: The social brutality of Gilgamesh selecting among enslaved people is sanitized into servants.

findings.highlight: there would not be a single meaningful person
findings.evidenceJa: 殺せない人間など出てきまい
findings.governingReading: not one person would emerge whom I could not kill
findings.explanation: The explicit horror is a claimed absence of anyone useful enough to spare; mirror moon states the inferred verdict while removing the act of killing that defines the test.

findings.highlight: A lot of something is ugly by itself
findings.evidenceJa: 多いという事は、それだけで気色が悪い
findings.governingReading: Multiplicity is, in itself, disgusting
findings.explanation: Visceral revulsion at sheer human abundance becomes an aesthetic judgment that “a lot” is ugly.

findings.evidenceJa: ぐちゃり、という音
findings.governingReading: a wet squelch
findings.explanation: The sound cue indicating soft bodies crushed underfoot becomes a generic hard impact.

findings.evidenceJa: 更に夥しく集る、有象無象の群
findings.governingReading: an even more innumerable swarm of nameless, undistinguished things clustering there
findings.explanation: The escalating multitude and 有象無象’s contemptuous link between insects and worthless masses are reduced to “more.”
